entities.summary: Ottoman Empire, a political institution in Jordan during Late Ottoman Transjordan (1916–1918). Grew from Arab Revolt forces advance through Transjordan toward Damascus and Hejaz Railway completed through Transjordan connecting Damascus to Medina. Led to the emergence of Hashemite-led Arab Revolt and Lawrence.
